mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 67 degrees with clear skies over Reddan Soccer Park and a waning crescent moon visible. Looking ahead, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 55 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Public Works Department reminds residents that they handle maintenance for streets, sewers, and utilities, and they encourage everyone to subscribe to the city newsletter to stay informed about local programs and infrastructure projects.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

In a report covering September 28 through October 5, officers responded to a serious incident on October 3 where a 19-year-old man was arrested for possession of a stolen firearm and a probation warrant.
Satisfy your cravings with today's flavor, Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, as the shop is open until 10:00 PM tonight.
